record.bible_text: The burden<WH04853> of the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> for Israel<WH03478>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, which stretcheth<WH05186><WTH8802> forth the heavens<WH08064>, and layeth the foundation<WH03245><WTH8801> of the earth<WH0776>, and formeth<WH03335><WTH8802> the spirit<WH07307> of man<WH0120> within<WH07130> him.
